result.summary: The intersection features sidewalks and traffic signals but lacks high-visibility pedestrian infrastructure. The crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and parked vehicles near the corner may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk in the foreground is heavily worn and barely visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side may block the view of pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the corner store

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental or ladder markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection equipped with a high-visibility continental crosswalk, traffic signals, and curb ramps. Safety is enhanced by flex-post daylighting at the corners, though intense sun glare and parked cars present significant visibility challenges.

hazards.name: Sun Glare
hazards.description: Extreme sun glare directly in the line of sight for drivers, which can blind them to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Modify signal timing to give pedestrians a head start, making them more visible to turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Permanent Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Replace flex posts with concrete bulb-outs to permanently shorten crossing distance and prevent illegal parking.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to slow traffic and increase the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized residential intersection with sidewalks and pedestrian signals on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded and the pavement shows signs of wear.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted lines for the crosswalk are heavily worn, making the crossing area less visible to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners can block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs of the side street

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway could pose a trip hazard or affect vehicle braking performance.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection and foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness and pedestrian safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street intersection featuring a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the crossing lacks signalization and is subject to visibility issues due to parked cars near the intersection.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk on both sides of the street may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street, flanking the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
